concept: Adapting physical goals and expectations as the body changes with age or circumstance
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult's physical capacity has changed (age, injury, health event) and their old standard of fitness no longer fits
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does physical excellence look like now, versus what it used to look like?
exercise.practice: Adult redefines what 'doing well physically' means for their current situation

assessment.success_marker: adult articulates a genuinely adapted, realistic standard rather than either giving up or clinging to an outdated one
